en_US: Riley: It’s good to see you again,
Now that you’re here, I can finally
give you that reward I promised
for helping us to defeat Team Rocket!
Oh, your party is full. I can’t
give you my gift in that case...
Riley: Within due course, that egg
will hatch into a {COLOR 2}Riolu{COLOR 0}.
When it does, I want you to
show it around the world!
I have no doubt that’s
in your capability, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!
Riley: I hope Riolu is doing well with
you. We should have a battle sometime
in the future, wouldn’t you say?
Buck: Hey, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}! How’s it going?
We should totally have a smoking
hot battle sometime!
Riley: Hello, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}. Has that Riolu
been happy with you? If it has, it’s
probably evolved into Lucario by now!
Anyway, judging by the look that’s
currently on your face...
Are you looking to battle? {YESNO 0}

messages.en_US: We’re going to pull out all the stops!

en_US: Intelligence is the key to
being a truly skilled Trainer.
With the right knowledge, your
chances of victory are much improved!

Perhaps I sensed your aura wrong...
Buck: Yeah! {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!
I’ve been hoping you’d show up!
How about we have that
smoking hot battle I mentioned! {YESNO 0}
I’m telling you, I’m seriously tough!
Act surprised!
Whew, too much!
I better get back to training!

between you and my brother would
be so awesome to watch!

That takes the wind right
outta my sails...
